messages:
ryan_sales: Quick ask 94 NovaHealth wants a 2-hour hosted POC next Thu. They need a temporary increase to 150 RPS for a 2h peak window, then back to a low baseline. Can we do a scoped ephemeral key + quota bump? Need cost estimate and approval workflow.
megan_se: Yes we can. A few clarifying q's: 150 RPS from a single client IP? payload sizes? streaming?
ryan_sales: Single client, non-streaming, inputs ~1.2KB, responses ~40-60 tokens. They prefer a hard cutoff when window ends.
kai_sre: Recommend a staged ramp: 25 -> 75 -> 150 over 10-15m to watch queueing. We should enable log sampling and trace headers for that key. We'll also set a hard token cap for the key as requested.
billing_bot: Quick cost calc: assume 60 tokens/resp average. 60 * 150 * 7200 = 64.8M tokens. At $0.0025/1k tokens ~= $162. Add 30% buffer + monitoring fees => estimate $210. We can invoice or charge card on file.
megan_se: Ops notes: we'll provision an ephemeral scoped key with TTL 4h and IP allowlist if they provide CIDR(s). Example admin call:
```
POST /admin/keys
{ "scope": ["generate"], "ttl": 14400, "ip_allowlist": ["198.51.100.0/24"] }
```
Then create a per-key quota exception for 150 RPS during the window.
ryan_sales: They will provide IPs. Confirmed window: 2025-07-02T14:00:00Z - 2025-07-02T16:00:00Z. Contact: alice@novahealth.com. Hard cutoff required.
kai_sre: I'll set a throttle policy: if 95p latency >600ms, return 429s to new requests and pause quota raise. Also add fallback routing to a lower-capacity variant if we hit capacity.
megan_se: I'll open ticket Q-4921 for the temporal quota and attach the key life info. Need infra sign-off day-of.
billing_bot: Note: if NovaHealth converts to Dedicated within 60 days we can credit up to 20% of this billed POC usage toward first monthly commit.
ryan_sales: Megan, can you get the key and final invoice number into this thread 24h before the start? I'll share with Alice and coordinate a smoke test.
deploy_bot: Reminder: create smoke test plan and a canary ramp schedule in the runbook. Template: runbook.redwood-inference.example/poc-smoke.
alice_novahealth: Thanks Ryan. We'll follow the ramp plan and provide IPs today. Hard cutoff is fine. Please DM the key.
megan_se: Will do. ETA: provisioning + invoice posted here by EOD tomorrow. I'll DM Alice the key with test curl snippet: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ephemeral" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"ping","max_tokens":50}' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate`.
ryan_sales: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
